expected.summary: Copies the practice project {doc}, as the template, into {dir}/Demo as Demo.prj; verified by the new project file.

rows.reason: project create always copies the template into a new or empty folder; there is no call with nothing to create (an occupied folder is refused as E_VALIDATION).

expected.summary: The new project's file must end in .prj; refused at the preview, nothing copied.
No template project at that path.

rows.reason: The command works in file mode on the project file named by its path and selects nothing by name, so nothing can match several objects; no two instances can report one project open (with two Designers running, both are unreachable and report no documents).

expected.summary: A Designer session has the template project {doc} open; the runtime refuses any file-mode write that names a project a session holds: E_CONFLICT file_open_in_session.
Run under a scope file that does not cover the target (the new project in {dir}); nothing is previewed to the application's files or sent.

rows.reason: This row applies only to a command that works in session mode or works in device mode.
This row applies only to a command that works in session mode.
This row applies only to a command that works in session mode or works in device mode or reaches the application through the host component.

A file-mode write reads and writes the project's files directly, and a file has no unsaved state of its own. A project Designer holds with unsaved changes is refused as file_open_in_session, which the conflict row covers.
project create is an artifact write verified only by the files it writes: the new .prj exists, with its size and SHA-256 recorded, checked in the same call; there is no stored value to read back.
